task_instruction: Add a Camera2D node centered on the playfield, attach a Camera2D.gd script that stores displacement, velocity, and the SPRING=900, DAMP=18, MULTIPLIER=20 constants, and implement a shake(right_pointed) method that reverses direction based on who scored. Update pong.gd so new_ball() keeps respawning the Ball and also calls Camera2D.shake() after every score. In _physics_process(), apply spring-damper physics to update velocity and displacement, then set position.x = displacement to drive the horizontal spring motion.
author_astra_first_failure: new_ball must trigger camera shake velocity change

--- original/scripts/Camera2D.gd
+++ solver/scripts/Camera2D.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+extends Camera2D
+
+const SPRING = 900
+const DAMP = 18
+const MULTIPLIER = 20
+
+var displacement: float
+var velocity: float = 0.0
+
+func _ready():
+	displacement = position.x
+
+func shake(right_pointed: bool):
+	if right_pointed:
+		velocity = -MULTIPLIER
+	else:
+		velocity = MULTIPLIER
+
+func _physics_process(delta):
+	velocity += (-SPRING * displacement - DAMP * velocity) * delta
+	displacement += velocity * delta
+	position.x = displacement
